card.name: Punctuation after brand drug names
card.fires_on: Punctuation and small joiners right after a brand drug name or inside a number or code, such as an opening parenthesis before the generic name. Also fires on a few joiners in lists of drugs.

modes.label: Bracket after brand name
modes.description: An opening parenthesis or bracket right after a brand name, where the generic name or a section reference follows.
modes.example: Pediatric use information is approved for AstraZeneca AB's Farxiga ®<< (>>dapagliflozin) Tablets

modes.label: Inside numbers and codes
modes.description: A decimal point, space or hyphen inside a dose, weight or disease code.

modes.label: Joiner in drug lists
modes.description: The word "and" or a count word inside a list or description of several drugs.
modes.example: intravenous daratumumab, subcutaneous daratumumab and hyaluronidase-fihj, isatuximab,<< and>> dexamethasone Prescribing Information

card.writes: The promoted tokens relate to digits and digital, so it may prepare for a number or a code to come next.
card.plain: It marks the spot right after a brand drug name or inside a number, where a generic name or more digits usually come next.
